decisions.reason: As a close-to-core candle-arch line that reuses established craftsmanship and materials, we would keep it because the carrying cost is still modest even though its recent market signal is weaker.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid remains firmly inside the firm's traditional product logic, so we would continue it as a low-risk assortment option unless clearer evidence of failure appears.

After several seasons without visible support, the more distant electronic music-box platform appears to have revealed limited strategic fit and insufficient upside relative to the core handcrafted business.
Because this accessory depends on the success of the distant music-box concept and is itself peripheral, its option value is now low and the resources are better redeployed.
This themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on proven capabilities and can remain in the range as a relatively inexpensive niche variant despite muted recent visibility.
